name: Brant Business Interiors
description: Brant Business Interiors is a family-owned Ontario commercial office furniture dealer at 296 George St N, Peterborough — toll-free 1-800-835-9565, quote response within 1 business day. Family-owned since 1964. OECM Supplier Partner under Agreement 2025-470. Part of the Office Central Group of Companies.

mainEntity.name: Are these desks and workstations OECM-eligible under Agreement 2025-470?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Sit-stand desks, L-shape and single-surface desks, multi-person workstations, executive suites, and reception desks in this collection are all covered under OECM Agreement 2025-470. Ontario school boards, hospitals, municipalities, colleges, and not-for-profits can issue an OECM purchase order without running an open RFP. Send the requisition to quotes@brantbusinessinteriors.com or call 1-800-835-9565 referencing Agreement 2025-470.

mainEntity.name: Which brands do you carry for desks and workstations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Brant Business Interiors is a storefront-authorized dealer for Global Furniture Group, OTG (Offices to Go), and Heartwood — the three brands you'll see most often across our desk and workstation builds. Heartwood is the typical pick for higher-end veneer and executive suites; OTG and Global cover the full range from single desks to multi-person workstations and benching configurations.

mainEntity.name: What should I know about sit-stand and height-adjustable desks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many of our sit-stand desks use electric motor lift columns, and many models offer programmable height presets; basic electric and manual hand-crank options are available where budget or simplicity is the priority. The top surface, leg colour, and motor configuration are usually quoted together as a single line. For multi-unit orders we send one quote that itemizes each desk and its options so procurement can audit line items easily.

mainEntity.name: Can you handle a multi-workstation office reconfiguration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We've installed open-plan workstation projects from a handful of desks up to floor-wide reconfigurations. The flow is: quote → free 2D space plan from our design team → confirmed PO → install on a single day or a rolling schedule with your facilities team. We deliver and install across Ontario from Peterborough, with one point of contact coordinating the project.
